string: Verita Health reads your pulse and checks facial symmetry using the camera. No images are stored or transmitted.
Verita Health uses motion data to detect a possible collapse (sudden fall followed by no movement) while the app is open.
If Verita Health ever detects a possible emergency, your last known location can be included in the alert sent to your emergency contacts.
Verita Health uses the microphone during Speech Check to screen for slurred speech, a stroke warning sign. No audio is stored or transmitted.
Verita Health uses on-device speech recognition during Speech Check to compare what you say against a test phrase.
